facts.fact: 莉莉镇定下来后放下背包，掏出当天早上从别墅顺走的手电筒。
facts.anchor: Once Lily caught her breath, she set her backpack down and pulled out a flashlight

facts.fact: 手电筒的光照亮了一只悬挂在头顶、张着大嘴的巨型美洲豹标本。
facts.anchor: a bright beam of light appeared and illuminated a larger-than-life stuffed jaguar hanging above them

facts.fact: 他们似乎位于一个小型竞技场的中层，配有体育场式座席，大小约等于当地歌剧院。
facts.anchor: they were at the middle level of a small arena with stadium-style seating

facts.fact: 竞技场有两层看台，每层约坐一百人，地面上用橙色大字写着“Feeding Frenzy”。
facts.anchor: There were two upper decks with seating for about a hundred people each

facts.fact: 米洛指出若把美洲豹和猎物关进竞技场，观众看到的将不是搏斗而是猎杀。
facts.anchor: If you put a jaguar in an arena with its prey, audiences aren’t going to see a fight

facts.fact: 失踪的乔丹突然出现，拿着莉莉的手电筒，衣服湿透、鞋上还粘着卫生纸。
facts.anchor: Jordan was standing there, holding Lily’s flashlight. Her clothes were soaked and a trail of toilet paper was stuck to her shoe

facts.fact: 乔丹找到的备忘录标有“confidential”，收件方是一个名为“Angel Investors”的组织。
facts.anchor: On the top of the memo was the word “confidential” written in bold type. It was addressed to a group called Angel Investors

facts.fact: 灯闪灭时有人把莉莉拽向电梯，眨眼间走廊尽头美洲豹的滑动门便被撞开。
facts.anchor: she would have been standing there moments later, when the sliding doors at the end of the hall shook and flew open
